"""Exhaustive tiny-plan tests: rerouting, bottlenecks and cost ties."""
import base64, itertools, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from harness import run, oracle, _info, feasible
import ipaddress

N1='2001:db8:1:1200::'
HEADER=('type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,'
        'result,service,attempt,payload')
LEASES=[{'id':'L','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],
         'low_count':4}]
SERVICES=[{'id':'web','kind':'tcp'}]
TARGETS=[N1+'1',N1+'2',N1+'3',N1+'4']

def build(seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    nreq=rng.randint(2,4); noff=rng.randint(2,4)
    rows=[]
    for i,t in enumerate(TARGETS[:nreq]):
        rows.append(f'icmp,p{i},0,9,put,L,1,0/i{i+1},{t},{t},echo,,,')
    data='\r\n'.join([HEADER]+rows)+'\r\n'
    requests=[{'id':f'r{i}','at':10,'lease':'L','target':TARGETS[i],'service':'web',
               'group':'g'} for i in range(nreq)]
    offers=[]
    for i in range(noff):
        subset=[f'r{j}' for j in range(nreq) if rng.random()<rng.choice([0.3,0.5,0.8,1.0])]
        if not subset and rng.random()<0.7: subset=[f'r{rng.randrange(nreq)}']
        offers.append({'id':f'o{i}','time':rng.choice([10,11,12]),'service':'web',
                       'prefix':rng.choice(['2001:db8::/32','2001:db8:1:1200::/56',
                                            TARGETS[rng.randrange(nreq)]+'/128']),
                       'capacity':rng.choice([1,1,2]),'cost':rng.randint(0,3),
                       'group':'o','requests':sorted(set(subset))})
    return {'version':3,'seed':'demo','leases':LEASES,'services':SERVICES,'queries':[10],
            'captures':[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(data.encode()).decode()]}],
            'requests':requests,'offers':offers,
            'request_quotas':[{'id':'g','parent':None,'capacity':rng.choice([9,9,2])}],
            'offer_quotas':[{'id':'o','parent':None,'capacity':9}]}

fails=0
for seed in range(1500):
    job=build(seed)
    out=run(job)
    if 'error' in out:
        print('seed',seed,'ERROR',out); fails+=1; break
    active={a['id']:a['active'] for a in out['active_requests']}
    request_info,offer_info,pairs=_info(job,active)
    # brute force over all subsets of the allowed pairs
    best=(0,0); best_choice=None
    for size in range(len(pairs),-1,-1):
        for choice in itertools.combinations(pairs,size):
            if not feasible(choice,request_info,offer_info,job['request_quotas'],
                            job['offer_quotas']):
                continue
            cost=sum(offer_info[o]['cost'] for _,o in choice)
            if size>best[0] or (size==best[0] and (best_choice is None or cost<best[1])):
                if size>best[0] or cost<best[1]:
                    best=(size,cost); best_choice=choice
        if best[0]==size and best_choice is not None:
            break
    got=(out['plan']['resolved'],out['plan']['cost'])
    if got!=best:
        print('seed',seed,'MINE',got,'ORACLE',best)
        print(json.dumps(job) if False else '')
        import json; print(json.dumps(job))
        print(json.dumps(out['plan']))
        fails+=1
        if fails>2: break
    # feasibility of the returned plan
    choice=[(a['request'],a['offer']) for a in out['plan']['assignments']]
    if not feasible(choice,request_info,offer_info,job['request_quotas'],job['offer_quotas']):
        print('seed',seed,'INFEASIBLE',choice); fails+=1; break
print('tiny plan tests done, failures:',fails)
PYEOF
